off the spreadsheet

Where the checklist habit comes from

The short version of a career change.

My first training was in health, not operations — a world that runs on checklists nobody gets to skip. Take the reading, log it, verify it, escalate the moment something looks off.

An order stuck in Processing for six days is a vital sign. A duplicate row is a chart with two names on it.

I brought the instinct with me: notice the small wrong thing early, write it down, and make sure the next person doesn't have to guess.
